notes: After acceptance, we ask to extend the inspection contingency to Fri Nov 13. The listing agent answers "we can extend the inspection period to the 14th" and "closing stays Dec 15": only contingency.inspection_until changes (Nov 9 -> Nov 14), closing and price stay. The day number is bare ("the 14th"), and it is not the date we asked for. Our question (Nov 13) states nothing. The amendment PDF later confirms the 14th; the counter PDF becomes partially stale. Distractors: $12,500 EMD, MLS #, HOA, sewer-scope fee, phone numbers.
